title: Healthy Ana and Her Father
text:
Ana wakes up early. She eats fruit and bread for breakfast. She walks to school every day. She drinks water all day.

Her father likes to run in the park. He does exercise three times a week. He goes to bed at ten o'clock. Ana and her father feel strong and happy.

questions.text: What does Ana eat for breakfast?
Where does her father like to run?
Why do Ana and her father feel strong?
options: Because they sleep in the morning

questions.text: What kind of person is the father?
options: Someone who does not like sport

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day
a clear liquid that people drink
physical activity done to keep the body healthy
having a lot of physical power

paragraph_translations: Ana acorda cedo. Ela come fruta e pão no café da manhã. Ela vai à escola a pé todos os dias. Ela bebe água o dia todo.
O pai dela gosta de correr no parque. Ele faz exercício três vezes por semana. Ele vai dormir às dez horas. Ana e o pai se sentem fortes e felizes.
